messages:
elaine (design): Heads-up — spotted two layout regressions on mobile console when viewing the 'Model runs' table on narrow widths. Rows are overflowing and the right-hand drawer pushes content off-screen. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/example :eyes:

mike (frontend): can you repro on iPhone SE / Android small?

elaine (design): Yep repro on Safari iOS 13 and Chrome Android 9. It starts around 480px width. Table cells don't wrap, the inline actions cause horizontal scroll. Drawer uses fixed width so it covers the action column.

anya (product): This is affecting the quick-debug flow — people open run details and then can't tap the breadcrumb to go back. Also copy in the drawer header is cluttered (long model name + version on one line).

jules (design): Proposed fixes: 1) make the table use responsive wrap at <= 520px: stack label/value rows and collapse less-used columns into a secondary accordion. 2) Drawer should be full-screen modal under 480px (slide-up pattern). 3) truncate model name, show full in tooltip.

mike (frontend): agree on slide-up for drawer. For table we can: a) use display:grid for rows with grid-template-columns: 1fr auto and allow word-break: break-word; b) hide less-critical columns via CSS at breakpoint. Will prototype.

sam (eng): watch perf for long tables — continuous virtualization + grid might interact weirdly. If we change DOM structure we need to keep row virtualization intact.

elaine (design): noted — add a collapsed row expansion to preserve virtualization per row rather than render full details inline.

aria-a11y-bot: a11y note — when converting drawer to full-screen modal on mobile, ensure focus trap and aria-modal="true". Also ensure close button is reachable via screen reader and the table reflow doesn't change reading order.

anya (product): small copy tweak: change drawer header from "Model run details: <full-name>" to "Run details — <short-name>" and put full name in small text with ellipsis. Improves scannability.

mike (frontend): I'll spike this afternoon. Plan: 1) add CSS breakpoint at 520px to switch table -> stacked layout, 2) drawer becomes bottom sheet at <=480px, 3) add tooltip/aria for truncated names, 4) keep virtualization by using row-level expansion.

jules (design): I'll update the figma frames for 375/420/520 widths and upload variants.

elaine (design): thanks — attached before/after mock: https://figma.com/file/example. QA checklist: no horizontal scroll on 360/412 widths, focus on close using voiceover, truncated name shows tooltip on long press.

sam (eng): FYI if we need server-driven columns (feature flag), we should expose a class toggle so CSS breakpoint rules can be overridden in edge cases.

mike (frontend): noted, will add a CSS hook and a feature flag check.

anya (product): timeline? We should try to get this in patch release next week — high UX friction for mobile users.

mike (frontend): targeting code PR by Thu, QA Fri.

elaine (design): thanks all. Adding acceptance criteria to the ticket: no overflow at 375/412/480 widths, drawer uses full-screen with accessible focus trap under 480, copy updated as discussed. :thumbsup:
